themes.name: Push notification controls
themes.description: Reviews about push or breaking-news notifications, including the lack of an in-app option to disable them, notifications that persist after being opened, or ones that keep arriving after being turned off. Also includes praise for useful news alerts.

themes.name: Live station streaming
themes.description: Reviews about streaming live radio and local stations: connecting, finding or losing stations, the live stream failing to start or stay connected, and dropped streams when switching networks or taking calls.

themes.name: Audio buffering and playback interruptions
themes.description: Reviews about audio that buffers, stalls, skips, jumps, rewinds, repeats, or cuts out mid-story or mid-podcast, and stories that start midway or fail to play through to the end.

themes.name: Playlist and queue
themes.description: Reviews about saving stories to the playlist or queue, including playlists that disappear on close or update, difficulty finding or reordering the playlist, and next-story behavior in the queue.

themes.name: Audio unavailable errors
themes.description: Reviews reporting error messages such as 'unable to play this media', 'no audio available', or 'can't connect', where programs, podcasts, or stories will not play at all.

themes.name: Landscape and tablet support
themes.description: Reviews about screen rotation, portrait-only orientation, and the app's layout or usability on tablets.

themes.name: Interface design and navigation
themes.description: Reviews about the look, layout, and ease of use of the app, including outdated or non-Material design, wasted screen space, the number of taps needed, and navigation of lists and stories.

themes.name: Background activity and battery
themes.description: Reviews about the app running constantly in the background, battery drain, memory use, inability to fully close or exit the app, and audio that keeps playing after closing.

themes.name: Chromecast support
themes.description: Requests for Chromecast or Google Cast support, often comparing the app with the NPR One app.

themes.name: Crashes and app stability
themes.description: Reviews about the app crashing, freezing, hanging, force closing, or glitching, including device-specific problems such as the Note 3 lock screen loop and crashes on opening photo captions.

themes.name: Updates and developer maintenance
themes.description: Reviews about app updates, regressions after updates, the app not being updated or maintained for years, and unresponsive developer support or feedback channels.

themes.name: Offline listening and reading
themes.description: Requests or comments about downloading podcasts and articles for offline use, and about the lack of offline access.

themes.name: Editorial bias and trust
themes.description: Reviews about NPR's political slant, perceived bias, or objectivity, and trustworthiness of its reporting, whether praised or criticized.

themes.name: News content quality
themes.description: Reviews about the quality, depth, and variety of NPR's news stories and programming, apart from the app itself.

themes.name: Article display and text options
themes.description: Reviews about reading articles in the app, including font size, display themes, missing images or charts, article loading, and how stories scroll or display.
